title: First Oracle Component
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, bit string $y$, and natural number $p$, the first oracle component, evaluated on the pairing of $y$ with the binary representation of $p$, returns the bit of $y$ at position $p$, with positions counted from $0$ and out-of-range positions interpreted as false.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
